name: LexEval
description: LexEval is a comprehensive Chinese legal benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on various legal cognitive abilities. It comprises 23 tasks and 14,150 questions, covering fundamental legal knowledge and ethical issues in legal applications.
reputation: LexEval is a recent Chinese legal benchmark that is gaining attention for broad coverage of legal reasoning and knowledge.
notes: Includes a new taxonomy of legal cognitive abilities and combines existing, exam, and newly annotated datasets by legal experts.
